assumptions: Baseline cloud spend is estimated between $5,000 and $50,000/month based on typical SMB to mid-market profiles.
Savings are derived from rightsizing compute, reserved instance/commitment planning, storage tiering, and idle resource cleanup.
Zion Tech Group services align with existing pricing tiers: Discovery ($99), Consulting ($499), Starter ($2,500/mo), and Growth ($8,000/mo).
FinOps automation assumes 1-2 full-time equivalents for the first 90 days, supplemented by consulting sprints.
Savings are realized gradually: quick wins in days 1-30, structural optimizations in days 31-60, and governance automation in days 61-90.
Cloud provider APIs and tagging standards are assumed to be accessible; no vendor contract renegotiations are included in the model.
Savings percentages are industry-aligned and not vendor-specific: low 10%, mid 20%, high 35% of monthly cloud spend.

low.notes: Assumes Starter-tier engagement with limited automation coverage and manual governance cadence.

mid.notes: Assumes Consulting plus partial automation. Governance cadence weekly. Mixed reserved instance coverage.

high.notes: Assumes Growth-tier engagement with full automation, continuous optimization, and multi-cloud chargeback reporting.

activities: Run Discovery engagement ($99) to map cloud accounts, tags, billing exports, and top spend services.
Identify idle/unused resources and apply immediate decommission or pause policies.
Establish baseline dashboards and tagging standards.
Deliver initial right-sizing recommendations for the top 20% of cost drivers.
Execute Consulting roadmap ($499) to validate savings model and prioritize workloads.
Implement reserved instance / savings plan coverage for steady-state workloads.
Automate storage tiering and lifecycle policies.
Introduce budget alerts, anomaly detection, and weekly FinOps review cadence.
Transition to Starter or Growth-tier automation ($2,500-$8,000/mo) for continuous rightsizing and forecasting.
Deploy chargeback/showback reports and integrate with internal finance workflows.
Train internal teams on FinOps policies and define escalation paths.
Re-measure savings and iterate on optimization backlog for next quarter.
